notes: מֵרָחוֹק is recast as a single English adjective with no word written for the preposition apart from the noun, so rule 30's one-rendering condition is met and the two share a unit headed on the noun (rules 30 and 40).
אַיִן heads on the negation word, not on the supplied frame (rule 50); the ASV writes *at home* with two words, so בְּ and בַּיִת each keep their own and only the suffix is unrendered.
